text: The 8.3 cosine and Euclidean similarity operator contracts accept arrays or BinData and return null when either input is null or missing. text: In r8.3.0, converting [NumberInt(200)] to BinData fails because array dtype selection rejects BSON int values outside [-128,127], rather than automatically widening them to FLOAT32. text: The vector specification requires FLOAT32 payload length after the two metadata bytes to be divisible by four. Non-PACKED_BIT padding must be zero; PACKED_BIT padding must be 0–7, and nonzero padding requires nonempty data. These requirements apply to vector APIs and decoding into vector structures, rather than establishing that every generic BSON operation validates vectors. (low confidence)
keywords: BinData subtype-aware aggregation dispatch and invalid inputs
